tasks.CheckArrayLength: Check if the array length is greater than 1 since an empty or single-element array is always sorted.
tasks.FindNonDecreasingSubarray: Identify a subarray where elements are in non-decreasing order.
tasks.ReturnResult: Based on the verification, return True or False.
tasks.VerifyRotationPossibility: Determine if the entire array can be rotated to form a non-decreasing sequence based on the identified subarray.
